Summary — Full-Stack Software Engineer with 2.5+ years of experience building scalable SaaS applications using React,
Redux, Tailwind, FastAPI, Django, Flask, and Spring Boot. Skilled in designing modern APIs, cloud-native backend systems, and
data-intensive pipelines across AWS, PostgreSQL, Redis, and RabbitMQ. Delivered AI-powered RAG search, optimized API
performance, automated CI/CD, and built multi-tenant platforms in Agile environments.

Full Stack Software Engineer

Led the launch of a cloud-based SaaS platform with 300+ MAUs in 5 months, implementing PostgreSQL
multi-tenancy to enable 5 state departments and increase adoption 5x.

Automated data migrations via Airflow, standardizing deployments and accelerating release cycles.

Built Django REST APIs and data models for 700K+ responses, enabling nationwide telecom analysis.

– Maintained data provenance using SQL Server triggers and audit tables for complete historical tracking.
– Supported automation of data migrations via Airflow, standardizing workflows and reducing manual effort

Heart Disease Prediction
Developed a heart disease prediction model using XG-Boost and SVM algorithms on a dataset of 300+ medical records.
– Achieved 99% recall and 97% accuracy , identifying high-risk patients with minimal false negatives.
– Deployed the model using Flask with an interactive JavaScript frontend, handling 100+ real-time predictions/day
– Tech Stack: Machine Learning, Python, Flask, JavaScript
Phishield Mails
Architected a secure email management system using APIs, enhancing efficiency and reducing API latency by 30%.
– Developed and deployed an AI-driven email classifier, reducing manual email sorting efforts by 45% and enhancing
phishing detection accuracy.
Optimized a React-based web app interface, processing 100+ mails simultaneously, boosting engagement by 25%
through an enhanced user experience.
Built an Angular prototype of an email analytics dashboard to explore component architecture, routing, and
service-based API integration for future migration.
Tech Stack: ReactJS, JavaScript, CSS, Generative AI, Google Auth, Web Analytics
Al Job Tracker
Developed a HATEOAS-compliant REST API for astronomers to record and share observations.
– Deployed a fault-tolerant AWS ECS system,implemented caching and asynchronous email alerts to improve
performance.
– Leveraged Redis and RabbitMQ for optimized caching and messaging, ensuring smooth scaling and reliability.
– Built cloud-native PoC on GCP to deploy microservice and evaluate portability, scaling, security, and cost.
– Tech Stack: Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, AWS, Redis, RabbitMQ
